description: This file contains database utility functions for managing PostgreSQL connections and executing queries, including context managers for connection and cursor handling, and functions to fetch one or all records or execute commands.

methods.name: Iterator["psycopg2.extensions.connection"] _get_conn()
methods.description: Provides a context-managed PostgreSQL connection based on configuration settings.

methods.name: Iterator["psycopg2.extensions.cursor"] _get_cursor()
methods.description: Provides a context-managed cursor with dictionary output for database operations.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None fetch_one(query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ())
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves a single row as a dictionary, or None if no result.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ())
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves all resulting rows as a list of dictionaries.

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ()) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ()) -> dict[str, Any] | None:$/
